text: 230 examples to learn from, 64 checks for tuning, 120 held out for the test. 8 labels.
Running live on Nebius Token Factory.
Base Nemotron 3 Nano got 87 of 120 held-out tickets right (73%).
Nemotron 3 Ultra scored 90% at $0.196 per 1,000 calls: the bar to chase.
Nemotron 3 Super found 3 failure types in 8 mistakes on the tuning checks.
Feedback mistaken as product question: Model confuses feature requests or general praise (feedback) with specific product inquiries due to overlapping language about features.
Billing mistaken as shipping: Model incorrectly assigns billing queries to shipping when text includes both payment and delivery terms, failing to prioritize intent.
Shipping confused with billing: Model mislabels shipping-related issues as billing when text mentions payment or charges alongside delivery, due to weak contextual disambiguation.
Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote 88 cases; Nemotron 3 Super agreed with 78. 10 dropped.
Wrote a playbook for Nemotron 3 Nano: 3 house rules and 6 worked examples from the agreed cases.
Taught Nemotron 3 Nano got 90 of 120 right (75%), up from 73%.
Shipped. Taught beats base by 3 of 120 held-out tickets (73% to 75%). Endpoint: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B + playbook.
